title: Part 13
content_zh: Words are not just wind. Words have something to say. But if what they say is not fixed, then do they really say anything? They may be different from the peeping of chicks. But is there really any difference? The Way is hidden by small accomplishments, and words are obscured by ornate rhetoric.
